AF-4 THE TWO L2-INCLUSIVE STRADDLES ARE REAL, NOT RESAMPLING OR ORDERING ARTIFACTS (audit diagnostics; frozen estimator untouched). (a) Paired bootstrap (audit diagnostic, exploiting within-trial reuse/cold correlation that the frozen unpaired bootstrap ignores): family-wise paired CIBF still straddles 1.00 on both cells — P1-ENDPOINT L2-inclusive [0.97603, 1.00028] and P3-PERMISSION L2-inclusive [0.97959, 1.00141] — so switching to the more efficient paired estimator would NOT convert either cell to WIN under the frozen Bonferroni bar; the frozen unpaired estimator is conservative here and the INCONCLUSIVE outcome is robust to this choice. (b) Order-split medians (parent AF-6 style): reuse-first vs cold-first R_L2 agree within 0.1-0.8% per class (P1 0.9906/0.9892; P3 0.9958/0.9879) and R_L3 within 0.3-1.6% (all well below 1.00); no ordering flip. (c) Dispersion: L2 episode distributions are roughly unimodal (P1 reuse sd 0.11ms on ~4.96ms median); one P3 reuse outlier (6.46ms) exists but median-based statistics are robust; the preregistered non-shrinking-dispersion failure mode did not occur — half-widths narrowed to ~1.3-1.6% as projected, and the residual straddle is driven by effect size (~0.05ms net gap), not by variance inflation.

AF-6 RESIDUAL-INTERPRETATION CAVEAT (does not change the frozen decision; bounds the producer's prose). The producer interprets the two MARGINAL cells as 'a true effect of ~1% sits below even the narrowed resolution'. Decomposition of the frozen phase deltas shows the L2-inclusive residual gap is not a pure reuse effect: NOARG gap ~0.133ms (P1) / ~0.129ms (P3) minus the disclosed S-ARG operand asymmetry (reuse deepcopies the full 5-mech dict, cold deepcopies {}; S-ARG delta_med ~0.078ms on all classes) leaves the ~0.05ms inclusive net gap. The two remaining straddles are therefore arithmetic-compatible with 'NOARG win ~2.6% minus a known implementation-artifact cost ~1.5%' rather than an unidentified ~1% scientific effect. The asymmetry was disclosed at DESIGN and is neutralized by the frozen both-boundaries requirement (the NOARG-only win cannot flip the cell), so the decision is unaffected; but the claim ceiling must not upgrade the residual to a positive '~1% reuse effect' finding. report.md's wording is acceptable only under this asymmetric-artifact reading.
